description: Test implementation for verifying Inter-Process Communication (IPC) functionality, including server commands, client interactions, and command handling logic.

methods.name: app__unhandled_command

methods.name: app__big_command
methods.description: Generates and replies with a large buffer of sequential lines to test long responses.

methods.name: app__chunk_command
methods.description: Replies with a series of lines, testing incremental response chunking.

methods.name: app__slow_command
methods.description: Replies slowly with lines, simulating an expensive computation.

methods.name: app__sendbytes_command
methods.description: Processes a 'sendbytes' command, verifying ballast data and response.

methods.name: bg_wait_cb
